blocks.prompt: 2 A culture grows according to \(N = 150e^{kt}\), where time \(t\) is measured in hours. After 10 hours, the population becomes 250. Find the growth constant \(k\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh bhi growth ka sawal hai, lekin is dafa waqt nahi, rate constant \(k\) unknown hai.
Diya kya hai? Shuru mein \(N_0 = 150\), aur 10 ghante baad \(N = 250\).
Find kya karna hai? Growth constant \(k\), jo power mein \(t\) ke saath baitha hai.
Rule kaunsa? Wohi: exponential ko akela kar ke \(\ln\) lena, kyunke \(\ln(e^{x}) = x\).
Plan: \(t = 10\), \(N = 250\) rakhenge, 150 se divide karenge, \(\ln\) lenge, aur aakhir mein 10 se divide.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(N = 150e^{kt}\); \(t = 10\) par \(N = 250\).
Maloom karna: growth constant \(k\).
Tareeqa: \(k\) power mein hai, is liye \(e^{10k}\) ko akela karenge aur \(\ln\) lenge. Growth ka sawal hai, to jawab positive aana chahiye; yeh baat aakhir mein check karenge.

\(t = 10\) aur \(N = 250\) rakhein
\[250 = 150e^{10k}\]
Kyun: 10 ghante baad culture 250 hai, yani yeh jora model ko poora karta hai. \(kt\) ki jagah \(10k\) aa gaya.

Exponential ko akela karein
\[\dfrac{250}{150} = e^{10k}\]
\[\dfrac{5}{3} = e^{10k}\]
Kyun: dono taraf 150 se divide kiya, phir fraction ko 50 se chhota kiya. Chhota fraction aage calculation aasan karta hai.

Dono taraf \(\ln\) lein
\[\ln\left(\dfrac{5}{3}\right) = 10k\]
Kyun: \(\ln(e^{10k}) = 10k\), power neeche aa gayi.

\(k\) nikaalein
\[k = \dfrac{1}{10}\ln\left(\dfrac{5}{3}\right)\]
\[= \dfrac{0.510826}{10}\]
\[\approx 0.0511\]
Kyun: dono taraf 10 se divide kiya. \(\frac{5}{3}\) ek se bara hai, is liye us ka \(\ln\) positive hai, aur \(k\) positive aaya. Growth mein yahi hona chahiye tha.
Dhyan dein: \(\ln\frac{5}{3}\) ko \(\frac{\ln 5}{\ln 3}\) samajhna aam ghalti hai. Sahi rule \(\ln\frac{5}{3} = \ln 5 - \ln 3\) hai.

Tasdeeq
\[150e^{10 \times 0.0511} = 150e^{0.511}\]
\[\approx 150 \times 1.667 \approx 250 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: jawab wapas rakhne se 250 mila, to \(k\) sahi hai.
